card.name: Diet and ACE in label text
card.fires_on: The word diet after lipid- or cholesterol-lowering, and the abbreviation ACE inside angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors. Also fires on a few linking words in drug-label sentences.

modes.label: Diet before statin or fibrate
modes.description: The word diet in instructions to start a lipid-lowering diet before the drug.
modes.example: Patients should be placed on an appropriate lipid-lowering<< diet>> before receiving Fenofibrate Tablets, US

modes.label: ACE abbreviation
modes.description: ACE in parentheses after angiotensin converting enzyme.
modes.example: Patients taking angiotensin converting enzyme (<<ACE>>) inhibitors, thiazide diure

modes.label: Linking words in warnings
modes.description: Short words like to, with or a inside label sentences about reactions or concerns.
modes.example: Early identification and management of immune-mediated adverse reactions are essential<< to>> ensure safe use of PD-1/P
